newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidek changes date of meeting.
newsitem.headline: Sidek changes date of meeting.

text.p: Mexican steel firm Grupo Sidek SA de CV said on Monday that it has changed the date of its annual shareholders meeting to May 30 from April 29.

Sidek's board of directors approved the change "in order to have enough time to allow the company to complete the auditing process being conducted by foreign auditors," Sidek said in a statement issued to the Mexican stock exchange.
The annual meeting now will coincide with that of Sidek's tourism subsidiary Grupo Situr SA de CV, also changed from April 29.
But the steel subsidiary Grupo Simec SA de CV still will hold its annual meeting on the original April 29 date, Sidek said.
